description_en: Queries the tag keys associated with Auto Scaling resources to facilitate a deeper comprehension of those resources. By doing so, you can categorize and manage your Auto Scaling resources more efficiently
description_zh: 调用API ListTagValues查询弹性伸缩资源标签键对应的标签值，能够帮助您更好地了解弹性伸缩资源，实现资源的有效分类和管理
kebab_example: aliyun ess list-tag-values --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type scalinggroup --key ESS --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagValues

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Auto Scaling resource
parameters.help_zh: 弹性伸缩资源所属地域的ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the Auto Scaling resource. Set the value to scalinggroup. This indicates that the tag is added to a scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 弹性伸缩资源类型。取值：scalinggroup，表示标签绑定的对象是伸缩组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The token that determines the start point of the next query. If this parameter is empty, all results are returned
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

NextToken.description_en: The token that determines the start point of the next query. If this parameter is empty, all results are returned
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 输入时设置的每页行数
